source_snapshot.procedure: Run amd-smi at five-second cadence, AGT PM logging for eight GPU mappings at 50 ms with clock restore, Redfish ambient/fan/PSU logging, at least one-minute idle bookends, then run the exact Coralgemm command for 900 seconds on one GPU at a time from logical devices 0 through 7 and collect synchronized logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: No hang or unintended reset; no GPU overheats or goes offline; review dmesg for throttling; GPU can reach Power Cap value.
source_snapshot.script: No source Script; 5 attended and 30 machine minutes, although eight 900-second serial runs plus bookends require a substantially longer planned window.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; retains an individual-GPU gemm workload and amd-smi but omits most synchronized telemetry and imports unrelated PCIe fault-injection/CPER evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION at HIGH risk; binds tools, topology, per-GPU serial workload, 50 ms/5 s/Redfish telemetry, power-cap oracle, abort limits and no-injection rule.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Partly aligned on Coralgemm and monitoring, but its single selected GPU wrapper does not cover the required eight serial runs and its RAS evidence belongs to the duplicate row.

original_test_intent: Characterize thermal, power, clock, cooling and performance response for each of eight GPUs under an individual 900-second Coralgemm load, verifying each remains online, within approved limits and free of unintended reset or disallowed throttling/error.
original_method: Establish synchronized amd-smi, 50 ms AGT and Redfish system telemetry, obtain an idle bookend, execute the exact 900-second gemm workload on one identity-bound GPU at a time for all eight GPUs, insert cooldown bookends, then correlate complete per-GPU performance and platform thermal/power evidence.
manual_activity: The owner approves workload artifacts, eight-GPU mapping, whether reaching the power cap is required versus permitted, safe thermal/throttle limits and the full multi-hour window; an operator supervises abort and recovery.
required_inputs: Eight GPU UUID/BDF/OAM/ROCR mapping and driver/firmware versions
Compatible amd-smi, AGT and Coralgemm/gemm versions/checksums
AGT 50 ms fields and Redfish ambient/fan/PSU sensor mapping
Per-GPU temperature, power-cap, clock, performance, throttle and error limits
Definition of idle/cooldown readiness rather than fixed 60 seconds alone
Correct total schedule for eight 900-second serial runs, storage, abort and console/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Preserve complete baseline logs and sensor state before any clear
Do not execute the duplicate PCIe LCRC injection or use CPER/BadTLP as thermal acceptance
Bind every ROCR index to a stable physical GPU identity before load
Begin all loggers before the first idle bookend and detect telemetry gaps
Abort the active workload on overtemperature, power excursion, unexpected throttle, GPU reset/offline, XID, ECC/PCIe event, performance failure or missing telemetry
Allow verified cooldown before advancing to the next GPU
No automatic retry after a safety or evidence failure
agent_execution_scope: Validate tools, GPU mapping, sensors, power-cap semantics and limits
Capture baseline and start synchronized amd-smi/AGT/Redfish/BMC/OS evidence
Confirm idle readiness, then run the exact gemm command on one approved GPU for 900 seconds
Capture full GFLOP output and monitor/abort conditions
Verify cooldown and health before selecting the next identity-bound GPU until all eight are covered
Produce common-axis per-GPU plots and facts without final verdict
engineer_actions: Approve toolchain, mapping, power-cap/throttle interpretation and full runtime
Confirm thermal/power headroom and dedicated system availability
Supervise stress, cooldown and any recovery
Review eight complete datasets and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The exact gemm parameters and 900-second duration fit one GPU, but the wrapper selects only one unbound numeric ID, truncates outputs and omits the complete eight-GPU serial sequence, 50 ms AGT and Redfish platform telemetry; CPER injection evidence is unrelated.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: For each verified GPU identity, execute `ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<mapped-id> ./gemm R_64F R_64F R_64F R_64F OP_N OP_T 8640 8640 8640 8640 8640 8640 96 900 strided` only after idle readiness, with full synchronized telemetry and cooldown gating.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: One GPU at a time, logical devices 0-7 after identity verification, exact matrix/stride arguments, 900 seconds each, amd-smi 5-second cadence, AGT 50 ms and minimum 60-second bookends remain; the 30-minute estimate is preserved as source metadata but cannot truncate the required runs.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind every GPU, synchronize all loggers, prove idle, execute and cool down each 900-second run serially, enforce limits and compare eight complete common-axis datasets.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable identity, objective bookends, realistic scheduling, lossless per-GPU evidence, explicit power-cap/throttle interpretation and removal of copied RAS injection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: One selected GPU or parallel execution does not cover the required individual-GPU thermal response; a 30-minute cap cannot contain eight serial 15-minute loads and bookends.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Even single-GPU load affects shared cooling and PSU response, while prior GPU heat can bias later runs unless cooldown state is measured rather than assumed.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC must resolve `GPU can reach Power Cap value` into a measurable expected threshold/tolerance and state whether throttling at cap is acceptable. Any reduced GPU set or shorter runtime is a declared coverage reduction.
expected_evidence: SUT and eight GPU UUID/BDF/OAM/ROCR mapping, firmware/driver/tool identities, limits and approval
Pre-test and per-run idle/cooldown readiness with ambient, fan, PSU, GPU temperature/power/clock state
Complete 50 ms AGT, 5-second amd-smi, Redfish platform and BMC/OS event streams
Full gemm GFLOP output and exit status for each of eight 900-second runs
Per-GPU synchronized plots, power-cap/throttle analysis and any reset/offline/XID/ECC/PCIe/abort event
Final all-GPU health, runtime/coverage accounting, no-injection audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The workload, monitoring and criteria consistently target sequential individual-GPU thermal characterization. The 30-minute machine estimate conflicts with the practical minimum duration but is scheduling metadata, while ambiguous power-cap acceptance is a Project oracle; neither obscures the core operation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Tool versions, GPU mapping, limits, power-cap meaning and realistic window are supplyable inputs. The source provides a concrete workload and meaningful safety direction.

review_improvement: Restores the full eight-GPU serial and synchronized telemetry scope, identifies the minimum-runtime discrepancy, rejects copied PCIe injection evidence and defines measurable cooldown and power-cap decisions.
independent_technical_reasoning: Individual thermal characterization depends on holding the stimulus to one known GPU while measuring shared-platform response. Without cooldown equivalence, run order becomes a hidden variable; without stable identity, a numeric index can change after a reset and assign later data to the wrong physical OAM.
